findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "edgar_insider_transactions" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "onchain_oracle_price" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: structured_json_repair, edgar_insider_transactions, onchain_portfolio, onchain_oracle_price · Private data: edgar_insider_transactions, edgar_13f_holdings, onchain_token_balances, onchain_portfolio, onchain_cross_chain_balances, onchain_oracle_price · Public sink: edgar_insider_transactions, edgar_13f_holdings · Destructive: tabular_to_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: structured_json_repair, edgar_insider_transactions, onchain_portfolio, onchain_oracle_price · Private data: edgar_insider_transactions, edgar_13f_holdings, onchain_token_balances, onchain_portfolio, onchain_cross_chain_balances, onchain_oracle_price · Public sink: edgar_insider_transactions, edgar_13f_holdings · Destructive: tabular_to_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
